scope: Descriptive measured CDM/control comparison in eight complete named-condition/polarity pairs; no fitted model or dose-response inference. Fixed windows frozen before reading the new CDM response values. Control traces previously used as development data.
observation: Stored rows 0=dark, 1=bright; t holds trailing 1/120-second bin endpoints. Exact time-overlap integration over predeclared windows; all 63 bins retained.
interpretationLimits: Chemical treatment is chlordimeform (CDM), an octopamine agonist applied to the brain bath in the source experiment; this is not airborne odor delivery or a demonstrated steering command.
Pairs match cell type and compact filename condition. Compact-label-to-physical-radiance mapping and animal pairing are not verified.

Control exports contain population means only. Individual CDM arrays are retained and checked against their means; trace counts are not assumed to be independent animals. No confidence interval or significance test.
Fixed early/late/recovery windows are descriptive and differ from the source paper's data-dependent phase analysis.
ASAP2f fluorescence is positive for hyperpolarization. No voltage calibration, offset, rescaling, dose, model parameter or initial-state fit is made.
Neither biological connectome steering nor flight performance is tested by this comparison.
